notes: One entity pair per call; all line types included; if compact seeds are used, expansion roundtrip must be validated by code outside the LLM.
causal_candidate_rules: Only material directional interactions are emitted; do not enumerate every co-occurrence.
A causal candidate is a hypothesis for P10, not a confirmed causal edge.
Require source and target node evidence, temporal precedence, and an explanatory path; otherwise place the gap in unknowns.
Theme similarity/resonance is not causal. Resonance remains disabled unless the separate R-06.2 P6 experiment is authorized.
candidate_identity_rules: P09 assigns candidate_local_id unique within the entity-pair scan artifact; the host canonicalizes it to candidate_ref = scan_artifact_id + "::" + candidate_local_id before P10.
P10 and all downstream artifacts preserve the exact canonical candidate_ref; they must not mint a replacement ID.
A candidate without a canonical candidate_ref or resolvable source/target evidence is blocked before P10.
